name: חִוִּי
summary: The Hivites, one of the clans descended from Canaan; Hamor, father of Shechem, was one of them. The derivation of the name is uncertain.

evidence.note: The Hivites appear alongside the Arkites and Sinites in the genealogy of Canaan.
Hamor, the father of Shechem, is called הַחִוִּי.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7iwwiy` (old root key חוי). The verbal derivation of the gentilic is uncertain.
